title: How Lester practised
summary: Lester practised all day in Minneapolis, and ran gig tunes like Body and Soul and Stardust through all keys.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Now, do you have any recollection of how Lester would practice? Did he used to practice at all?
Yeah. He used to practice all day long, the boys told me, in Minneapolis. But after he got with us, he didn't practice too much.
So you have no idea what he practiced.
You don't know if he ever went in for scales and all that kind of stuff.

No, no. He didn't go for that. He practiced some of them numbers, like "Body and Soul" and "Stardust," all of them numbers they call gig numbers; to show you what you know about your horn -- that will learn you about your horn and your instrument. They would experiment on those.
Would he practice taking numbers through all the keys?
Yeah. Those jam numbers. You find out what you know about your instrument, running through all them keys.
